name: 海洋5
group_note: same lineage as 146 (hy, base haiyang archive) -- same duplicate-create() ftpd.lpc fix (§7.40) and author_file() recursion guard; finished an interrupted conversion (58882-file archive originally timed out mid-convert); fixed efun::message() exc_target=0 rejection in tell_room(); boots clean. Full WASM pass: added loopback-allow to band.lpc's is_banned(); fixed the same euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug as 146/hy in adm/daemons/logind.lpc (create(), howmany_user(), make_body() all changed to seteuid(ROOT_UID)); guarded howmany_visitor()/howmany_card() against missing counter files; fixed check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds (4-10 -> 2-5, dropped the i%2==0 gate, is_chinese() called per-character); guarded adm/daemons/securd.lpc's get_status() against the same reentrant-compile member_array() crash as 146/hy (arrayp(wiz_levels) check). Also found a NEW bug not present in 146/hy: adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc's startup_udp()/send_udp()/send_shutdown() call socket_create/socket_bind/socket_close unconditionally (no sockets package under WASM), failing to COMPILE the whole file -- since gb_big5() transitively touches this daemon, the compile failure silently broke the entire registration flow (no input_to(get_id) ever registered, so all further input fell through to the ordinary command parser). Fixed by gutting the socket-dependent bodies to no-ops, same pattern as §7.52's mudlistd.lpc. Admin seeded directly into adm/daemons/securd.o's wiz_status mapping (same non-wizlist mechanism as 146/hy), edited with binary-mode file I/O. Registration through world-entry and admin recognition both verified; this lineage's Big5 prompt actually expects g/gb or b/big5 (not y/n) -- do not assume the same prompt semantics as a similarly-worded 146/hy prompt.
